race.comment: Open race to kick us off. DRACENA (1) has had three runs back from a lengthy spell and will be ready to peak now. Has placed around this circuit and maps ideally for this from gate four. Rates the testing material against this line-up. APOLLO TEN (3) gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim and is more than capable enough on his day. Looms as the main danger. FORT WILLIAM (4) has a win and two placings from four attempts over this track and trip and is another to get some weight off. Top-three credentials. PUREZZA (9) is a four-time winner here on her home surface and only needs some luck from the sticky draw to be featuring in the outcome. HEAVENLY LOVE (6) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
